about: A/B test, Oct 5, 2026 (owner's request): panels 3 and 5, and panel 2 as a night reference, on two Apache-2.0 open-weight models served by fal.ai, prompted as true night scenes with no grade step. Text-to-image only: no reference images, so Deluin is described in words. Test output only; nothing here is published, and the pipeline's model is unchanged. The style prompt is techno-vistas with its two daytime clauses ('big pastel skies and enormous elegant megastructures on the horizon', 'clean and bright and hopeful') left out for night. Prompt expansion is off, so the prompt recorded is the prompt used. Hard cap: $1 for the whole test.

jobs.prompt: Night, seen from inside a dark Arctic room of pale faceted crystalline wall panels, looking out through a large frosted window. Far across snowy forested hills a long line of small moving lights threads through black pine trees, and on the horizon a large orange fire blazes among the trees, smoke rising into a starry night sky. The fire is the brightest thing in the picture; the room is lit only by its distant glow. It is the middle of the night: a black sky, no daylight, no sunset, no pastel colors. Detailed science fiction comic art: precise fine uniform linework, rich mechanical and architectural detail kept to the middle and far distance, cel-shaded flat color with soft hard-edged shadows, cinematic wide-angle perspective, no text, no lettering, no writing, no logos, no numbers.

Close-up at night of one right hand, five fingers, resting flat on top of the glass of a sleek pale console in a dark room. The wrist and forearm are in the sleeve of a thick cream cable-knit sweater. Only this one hand and sleeve are in the picture; the fingers rest on the surface and do not pass through it. Across the console's display flows a soft stream of pale green abstract waveforms like heartbeat lines, with no letters or numbers, and one thin bright thread of warm light slips out of the stream into the dark. The room is dark, lit only by the display. It is the middle of the night: a black sky, no daylight, no sunset, no pastel colors. He is the only person in the room.
